basic_details.scholarship_name: University of Melbourne Graduate Research Scholarships
basic_details.offering_entity: University of Melbourne & Australian Government Research Training Program (RTP)
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: University of Melbourne (Parkville, Southbank, Burnley campuses)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Open across all faculties: Engineering & IT, Medicine, Dentistry & Health Sciences, Science, Arts & Humanities, Business & Economics, Law, Veterinary & Agricultural Sciences, Fine Arts & Music.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~600 scholarships awarded annually (covers domestic and international)
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open globally; approximately 300 awards reserved for international graduate researchers
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Up to 2 years for Master's by Research; up to 3.5 to 4 years for Doctoral (PhD) degrees

nationality_requirements: Open to international citizens of all countries including Pakistan
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed at least a 4-year undergraduate degree with substantial research project (minimum 25% research) or Master's degree by research from an accredited institution.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum equivalent to University of Melbourne First Class Honours (H1 - 80%+ or 3.70+ / 4.00 CGPA).
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Substantial research background in the proposed discipline with prior thesis or publications.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or in final semester of research master's or 4-year honours bachelor's degree.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Research publications, conference proceedings, or relevant industry R&D experience significantly enhances competitiveness score.

english_proficiency.notes: IELTS Academic 6.5 (no band below 6.0) or TOEFL iBT 79 (writing 21, speaking 18, reading 13, listening 13); higher for Law/Humanities.

eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Must not have already completed a research degree at the same or higher level.

tuition_fee.details: 100% Full Tuition fee offset (covers all tuition fees up to AUD $110,000 for Masters or AUD $175,000 for PhD).

admission_application_fee.details: University of Melbourne application fee (AUD $130) paid by applicant (waived during certain promotional events or via faculty invitation).

accommodation.details: Living expenses covered by living allowance.

monthly_stipend.details: Full tax-free living allowance paid fortnightly.

airfare.details: Relocation grant provided upon relocating from outside Victoria/overseas.

visa_fee.details: Australian Student Visa (Subclass 500) application fee (AUD $1,600) paid by candidate.

health_insurance.details: Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) Single membership fully covered for the duration of the student visa.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Faculty research travel grants and lab computers provided.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Faculty travel grants of AUD $2,000–$4,000 available for conference presentations.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: University of Melbourne (Ranked #1 in Australia, Top 15 globally in QS).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: QS World Rank #13; Times Higher Education #37.
available_majors: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Sciences, Clinical Medicine, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, Veterinary Medicine, Law, Economics, Arts & Design
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 2 years for Masters by Research; 3.5 to 4 years for PhD
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: All candidates who apply for a graduate research degree are automatically considered for the Graduate Research Scholarship.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Securing prior in-principle endorsement from a Melbourne faculty supervisor is critical before formal application.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Ensure your Pakistani undergraduate/master's thesis grade is explicitly documented with a research score calculation.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: University of Melbourne Online Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the University of Melbourne graduate research application system, upload research proposal, and nominate potential supervisors.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Find a prospective supervisor in your discipline and obtain in-principle endorsement (June-August).
3. Submit formal graduate research course application online by the deadline (Round 1: October 31).
4. Check the box indicating consideration for Graduate Research Scholarships.
5. Upload academic transcripts, English scores, and publications.
6. Provide referee reports via online referee tool.
7. Outcomes released in January/February for Semester 1 (February/March) start.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated single application for degree admission and scholarship.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by referees via Melbourne electronic referee report system.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Demonstrate your research background, motivations, and feasibility of proposed research project.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Detailed research proposal outlining research aims, methodology, background, significance, and preliminary bibliography.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV listing academic qualifications, research publications, awards, and professional research roles.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Supervisors or departmental committees usually conduct informal 30-minute video interviews before issuing supervisor endorsement.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE not required; English language proficiency mandatory.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: AUD $130 (waived if supervisor provides waiver code).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Certified transcripts and degree certificates from Pakistani universities; HEC attestation required.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% Online via University of Melbourne portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: 1,500 to 2,500-word proposal aligned with faculty research focus
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Developed in coordination with prospective Melbourne supervisor

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete transcripts for all undergraduate and postgraduate degrees
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Must clearly state research thesis component and credit hours

required_documents_checklist.specification: Copies of published journal articles, conference papers, or book chapters
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Peer-reviewed publications are crucial for competitive international ranking

required_documents_checklist.specification: Submitted directly by university research supervisors
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From professors who supervised your BS/MS thesis in Pakistan
Electronic score report sent to University of Melbourne

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Round 1 deadline is October 31 (for Feb/March start); Round 2 deadline is April 30 (for July start).

selection_process_and_weights.academic_weight: 40% (First Class Honours H1 equivalent GPA in bachelor/master)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Faculty Research Committees and Melbourne University Central Scholarships Committee.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Competitive faculty merit ranking score (H1 80+ benchmark) combining GPA and research output score.

competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Candidates with a published journal paper or multiple conference papers and 3.8+ GPA.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of leading Pakistani universities (NUST, LUMS, Quaid-i-Azam, UET Lahore, Aga Khan University).
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: China, India, Pakistan, Iran, USA, UK, Singapore.

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized agents promising 'guaranteed Melbourne research scholarships'.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee of AUD $130 applies; scholarship application has no extra fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: University of Melbourne accepts direct applications; research applications should be handled personally with professors.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Initial living expenses before first fortnight stipend payment.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You can get this scholarship without prior contact with a professor. (Fact: In most faculties, including Engineering and Science, you must have confirmed supervisor support before applying).
MYTH: Coursework Master's students get this scholarship. (Fact: Strictly for Master's by Research and PhD candidates).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: External blogs quote outdated stipend values of AUD $31,000; the official rate is now indexed at AUD $37,000+ per year.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must achieve satisfactory progress in annual research confirmation milestones (Confirmation of Candidature at 12 months).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time on-campus research candidature in Melbourne, Australia.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Annual progress reports signed by supervisory committee and head of department.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Permitted to work up to standard research student guidelines (typically up to 6-8 hrs/week during normal research hours, or tutoring/demonstrating).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; scholars are eligible for Australian Temporary Graduate Visa (Subclass 485 - Post-Study Work stream) for up to 3 to 4 years post-PhD.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Termination of scholarship occurs if student fails confirmation milestone or withdraws from research program.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing research projects within the faculty is permitted subject to supervisor and faculty approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: PhD scholarships may be extended for up to 6 months in exceptional circumstances with documented research delays.

official_sources_verified.source_name: University of Melbourne - Graduate Research Scholarships Portal
data_points_missing_or_unpublished_by_so: Exact faculty-by-faculty scoring rubric that converts Pakistani CGPA into Australian H1 equivalents
Internal allocation quotas between different academic departments
